evidence.title: Neuma · Build an agent of your own

name: Neuma
summary: Self-paced course that teaches non-programmers to build a personal AI system with Claude Code.
description: A 20-module course (9 foundation, 9 advanced, 2 bonus) plus a starter kit of roughly 15 plain markdown template files. It teaches one loop — describe, review, redirect — by building a personal AI operating system: identity, memory, daily briefings, energy-based tasks and a coaching layer, then subagents, orchestration, websites and an iOS app. Aimed at designers, writers, founders and managers with no coding or terminal experience.
contains: starter kit of ~15 markdown template files
teaches a personal AI operating system: identity, memory, daily briefings, coaching
advanced track: subagents, parallel orchestration, iOS app build
bonus modules: first website and Figma to code
